description: Makes the boundary of a tagged selection of a triangle (2D) or tet (3D) mesh manifold: around each of its non-manifold vertices and edges it carves an offset of the given radius and fills it with fill_tags (ambient by default).

input.description: Input mesh, .msh: a tagged triangle (2D) or tet (3D) mesh. Tagged faces (2D: tagged edges) and feature curves are refused: they are not carried yet.

input_dir.description: Directory where the input files are located. This is injected by the application and should not be set by the user.

tag_selection.description: Tag selection, the boundary of which is taken to be the input surface to make manifold. An expression of tags: names, &, |, ! and parentheses.

fill_tags.description: Tag set to fill non-manifold offsets with. [] for ambient.

radius_rel.description: Radius to offset around non manifold components, relative to bounding box diagonal.

radius.description: Radius to offset around non manifold components. If < 0, this is set by radius_rel

DEBUG_output.description: Write the tet mesh as out_{}.vtu after every operation.

write_surface.description: Write the output surface (OBJ) after manifold extraction.

log_file.description: Logs are not just printed on the terminal but also saved in this file.

report.description: A JSON file that stores information about the result and the method execution, e.g., runtime.

envelope.description: The envelope of a tagged mesh input: on the memory route the name of an input mesh, on the file route the path of a mesh file, relative to input_dir as the input is -- the envelope tetwild, triwild and simwild return (outputs["envelope"]) and write (<output>_envelope.msh), labelled by the tags it holds. In 3D a labelled envelope is a reference, held to as topological_offset holds one: the run throws for a label the held faces carry that it lacks, and for a held face received outside its labels' envelopes, before anything is carved; the envelopes' half-width is the offset's default, 1e-3 of the bounding box diagonal (topological_offset's envelope_size_rel), so a mesh a sender held to a wider eps is refused. It is returned with the faces the carving made added, each between a carved cell and the rest and under the labels of the regions it separates -- new geometry, its own reference (on the file route <output>_envelope.msh) -- so that a chain keeps passing the first component's input on to the components after it. Until 2026-11 it was carried unchanged in 3D too, and a later simwild refused the carved faces outside it. In 2D it is carried, returned unchanged, while the extraction builds its envelopes around the mesh it receives. Its triangles (2D: segments) stand for the input's EnvelopeSurface group, which it cannot be combined with.

title: manifold_extraction
